ivy (engineering): Quick sync: drafting internal announce for 1.5.0 roll (EU). Cutover window 04/03 22:00-23:30 UTC. Need pin + rollback language check.

sara (product): sending eyes. will we embargo external comms until final stage?

ana (eng-sre): yes prefer embargo until 100% ramp. ops needs pins: model + infra.

ivy (engineering): pins added: model redwood/llm-3b@v1.5.0, fallback redwood/llm-3b@v1.4.2, infra: eu-dedicated-9.

elaine (docs): internal blurb draft: "Heads-up: rolling 1.5.0 to EU (canary 04/03 22:00 UTC). Expected: latency improvement and ~10% cost drop. Canary staged with rollback thresholds. Oncall: @daniel, @ana. Postmortem/template link attached."

daniel (oncall): For runbook: thresholds -> errors >=2.5% over 5m OR p95 >650ms over 10m OR eval drop >1.8% => abort/rollback. Also require manual approval to resume after abort.

ivy (engineering): Canary plan: 5% traffic 20m, 20% 20m, 60% 25m, then 100%. Auto-abort on thresholds.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued job_id=deploy-1743332100-1 target=eu-dedicated-9 model=redwood/llm-3b@v1.5.0

elaine (docs): internal announce short: "Rolling 1.5.0 to EU (canary 04/03 22:00 UTC). Starts staged; rollback criteria set. Do not escalate externally unless rollback occurs. See dashboard + template."

sara (product): OK to send internal T-20. embargo external til stage 3.

ana (eng-sre): infra +1. I'll watch GPU OOMs and shard health.

daniel (oncall): I'll prep rollback snippet in pager: 
``
deploy-bot rollback --job deploy-1743332100-1 --to redwood/llm-3b@v1.4.2
```

ivy (engineering): Final checklist: notes (elaine), pins (ivy), thresholds (daniel), deploy queued (deploy-bot), announce copy ready (sara). Sending T-20 internal notify. Thanks. :thumbsup:
